planting.note: Plant out after frost danger passes; grows well in containers that can be moved to shelter in winter.

directions: Forms a compact, spiky rosette of inch-wide, dark green leaves overlaid with a waxy minty-green bloom and heavy burgundy spotting that intensifies with sun exposure. Tiny marginal spines and a sharp terminal spine give the foliage a pineapple-crown look. Grow in full sun with excellent drainage, watering moderately in summer and keeping nearly dry in winter. An intergeneric Agave x Manfreda hybrid, it matures faster than pure Agave while retaining drought and heat tolerance.

planting.note: Set out after frost in full sun; bring containers indoors or to a greenhouse where winters drop below 60F.

directions: A large, refined rosette of broad, deep red leaves that holds its color best in full sun. Growth is slow and measured, so plants hold their shape for years without quickly outgrowing their space. As an Agave x Manfreda intergeneric hybrid it finishes faster than a pure Agave while keeping excellent drought tolerance. Water lightly through summer growth and keep nearly dry over winter.

planting.note: Plant in full sun after frost; among the larger and more upright striped mangaves, needing a bit more room than compact selections.

directions: Stiff, arching leaves carry dark green margins around a central band of lighter green, giving a bold striped effect. It grows into one of the largest and most upright-habited of the striped mangave selections. Give full sun and sharp drainage, watering sparingly and keeping dry through winter. This Agave x Manfreda hybrid combines Manfreda's faster growth and patterning with Agave's refined form.

planting.note: A compact selection well suited to framing larger specimens in mixed succulent containers.

directions: Compact rosettes of green leaves are so heavily overlaid with clear red spotting that the foliage appears banded in solid red with narrow green margins. Red coloring intensifies with stronger sun exposure. Grow in full sun with well-drained, dry to average soil, watering lightly in summer and keeping dry over winter. This small, slow-growing Agave x Manfreda hybrid finishes faster than a true Agave of similar size.

planting.note: Part of the Art and Sol Mangave Collection; grow solitary in containers or mixed with other succulents and tropicals.

directions: Thick, arching leaves are light green beneath a heavy waxy coating, revealing faint light blue-purple spotting underneath, with defined teeth along the margins. It tolerates a wider range of moisture than most Agave relatives, making it adaptable to mixed plantings with annuals and tropicals. Grow in full sun with good drainage, watering moderately in the growing season and keeping nearly dry in winter. An Agave x Manfreda intergeneric hybrid, it combines Manfreda's vigor with Agave's refined rosette form.

planting.note: A refined, circular rosette that stays tidy in containers; increase sun exposure to bring out purple tones.

directions: Narrow, sword-like leaves shade from silvery green to purple, edged with a thin cinnamon-orange margin, and develop scattered purple dots under strong sun. The leaves are thinner and less rigid than typical Agave foliage, making the plant easy to handle. Grow in full sun in well-drained, dry to average soil, watering lightly through the growing season and keeping dry in winter. This Agave x Manfreda hybrid forms a tidy, circular rosette and finishes faster than comparable pure Agave selections.
